note: An EXAMPLE of the pack-marks/1 shape; it marks no real pack. The marks are the operator's and live on the machine, in ~/.sshlg-skills/pack-marks.json, written by `npx sshlg-skills visibility marks --init --show <owner/repo,...> --apply` (preview without --apply). hidden=true hides a pack's skills from a host's model listing through that host's own switch; nothing is deleted. A skill used in the last 60 days (by Claude Code usage) stays listed, and a family pack (ssheleg/*) is never hidden. Fabric's RM-23 (open) is to read the machine file as well.
